body:
Long product explanations currently keep selected comments waiting, while crash recovery can leave uncertain media work. This branch combines Agent 2 and Agent 3 in order and implements the real PostgreSQL adapter, consistent policy/fact projections, guarded boundary completion and resume, persistent legacy/durable exclusion, and authenticated manual UNKNOWN/Stop recovery surfaces.

Durable LIVE remains default-off and explicitly rejects `OUTPUT_FENCE_UNPROVEN`. This is a blocked integration for review; it is not an accepted production v0.5 release.

Implemented:
- Eleven generated Turn Manager operations backed by durablelive.Store; same authenticated scope, request hashes, revision CAS and epochs.
- Existing Scheduler integration with preserved merged comment identities and persisted fairness history; source cap is opt-in so legacy merge counters retain their behavior.
- Current product fact revalidation, WAITING admission/claim transitions, trusted drain-to-business checkpoint coordination, gap-aware resume and stale-epoch boundary handling.
- Managed Sessions reject legacy control and late lifecycle auto-start; owner-authenticated read/decision/Stop endpoints and recovery panel retain exact decision identity across ACK loss.
- Runtime permit expiry fences in-flight renewal and completed journal tasks release bounded local state.

Validation at tested code commit `597ece2840c9a56b3998739cd86a4c749588bdeb`:
- Full Go + race with dedicated PostgreSQL/Redis: each 142 top-level PASS, 0 FAIL, 3 documented SKIP; go vet and diff check pass.
- Runtime: 158 PASS, 11 opt-in SKIP; Journal 11 PASS; contract tests 17 PASS and frozen baseline checks pass.
- Frontend: 45 PASS and production build pass. Additional legacy in-process aiortc: 4 PASS, synthetic providers only.
- Real isolated Go/Python HTTP/process crashes, SQL/Redis outages, lease/CAS races, lost ACK, UNKNOWN/gap, Stop and duplicate completion tests passed at component level. All 20 recorded runner commands exit zero, source manifest unchanged, owned services cleaned up.
- Real GPU, Chrome, durable WebRTC/RTMP, official viewer, whole-host restart and busy-speaker latency: NOT TESTED / BLOCKED. Zero real latency samples.

Release blockers:
1. Depends on #7: Agent 1 and affected owners must approve answer-prepared CCR before changing frozen durable-live-1. COMMENT START remains fail-closed; tests using in-process RecordAnswerText do not resolve the cross-process gap.
2. Production Guardian does not yet own and physically isolate publisher credentials, FFmpeg and WebRTC resources. No new durable LIVE admission is possible.
3. Formal physical Session/Provider Binding lifecycle, trusted service registration and production SCRIPT/COMMENT media executors/all-required drain observers remain incomplete; full production recovery and real-media acceptance must follow.

Original PR #6 `55c4dad81545a04946b4d58b706fc6abb14e67fa` and PR #5 `ed2ebb235cb89e4b10b8a6f9670c6a1be00b1511` remain merge ancestors. No experimental Golden branch was included, no frozen media wire was changed, and no shared service or real live room was killed.

All nine delivery reports, conflict decisions, raw command JSON/logs, resource observations and the 15-item release matrix are under `docs/v0.5/`. Start with `AGENT-4-HANDOFF.md`, `INTEGRATION-REPORT.md` and `RELEASE-GATES.md`.

**ASTRALIVE V0.5 BLOCKED** — do not merge or enable as an accepted release.
